failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 query: 'What are the characteristics of Route 611 in Afghanistan, including its length and the towns it passes through, and what is the relationship between Sangin and the Helmand River watershed system of the Sistan Basin?' Hop 3 query: 'What is the length of Route 611 in Afghanistan, and does it pass through a town located in the valley of the Helmand River, which is the primary watershed for the Sistan Basin?' Both queries ask for the same information already answered in hop 1 (Route 611 length, Sangin location in Helmand valley). Hop 2 retrieval returns identical documents to hop 1. Hop 3 retrieval also returns the same core documents (Route 611, Sangin, Helmand River, Sistan Basin passages).

failure_modes.name: Solver_Irrelevant_Passage_Overprocessing
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 1 solver reasoning extensively analyzes passages [5] Steptoe Valley (Nevada), [6] Hollywood Freeway (Los Angeles), and [7] Drangiana when the claim verification was already complete using passages [1], [3], and [4]. Solver states 'From passage [7]: This confirms that the Helmand River is the primary watershed for the Sistan Basin' when passages [4] already established this fact directly and passage [7] (Drangiana historical region) adds no new verification value.
